transcript.content: Hi, I'm Dr. Smith. How are you today? Can you tell me what's been bothering you?
I've just been feeling extremely depressed and empty inside for the past six months. It feels like a constant, heavy sadness that I just can't seem to shake off.
Have you had these feelings of sadness for most of the day, more days than not, for at least two years, or is it more of a recent development over the past few months?
It's definitely more of a recent development. This heavy sadness started about six months ago, and it hasn't been going on for two years.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in most activities that you used to enjoy?
Yes, I really have. I don't care about any of my old hobbies anymore, and everything just feels completely dull. I just don't get any joy or pleasure out of anything these days.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight recently—like eating much more or much less than usual?
No, I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my appetite or weight recently. My eating habits have stayed relatively normal.
Have you been having trouble sleeping—like difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or sleeping too much?
No, I haven't really had any significant trouble with my sleep. I haven't noticed any major changes in my sleeping patterns lately.
Have you been feeling more tired or fatigued than usual, even when you haven't done much physically?
No, I haven't really noticed feeling unusually tired or fatigued. My physical energy levels seem to be pretty much the same as they've always been.
Have you been feeling excessive guilt, worthlessness, or self-blame lately—more than what would seem appropriate?
No, I haven't really been feeling particularly guilty or worthless, and I don't think I'm blaming myself excessively for things. It's more that I just feel completely empty and sad all the time.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or feeling restless and unable to sit still?

Yes, I've actually noticed both of those things. Sometimes I feel really restless and find it hard to sit still, but at other times, I feel like my movements and speech have become noticeably slower than they used to be.
Has this sadness and loss of interest made it difficult for you to function at work, school, or in social relationships?

Yes, it has made functioning really difficult. I have no motivation to do my work or complete daily tasks anymore. I've also been pulling away from my friends and family because I just don't have the energy or interest to maintain those relationships.
